images.caption: Free domain email is where free options are weakest. Google Workspace is the paid, full-mailbox option.

images.title: The costs you can't avoid
images.alt: Three cards on what a free stack still costs: a domain renewed every year, a fee on every payment, and your own time.
images.caption: Before the first sale, the only bill should be the domain.

items.title: The domain
items.text: Paid every year; check the renewal price, not just the first year
